name: The quiet shore

systems.text: Water advancing from the northern shore. Walking residents choose nearby inland corridors unless you broadcast guidance.
Glass Garden evacuation ledger confirmed: all residents relocated before this shift.
RELAY FAILURE: location fusion unreliable. Repeated transmissions may refer to the same group.
RELAY RESTORED: fresh position fixes online.
Final inland sweep. Reception hubs remain above the waterline. Units already carrying residents will complete their return.

noise: ORBIT STORE: your wishlisted game is 40% off. This offer survives the weekend.
CALENDAR: team sync in Conference Pod 4. Attendance is still marked mandatory.
RABBIT NEWS: reporter asks whether the command center has a comment.
PERSONAL: the station cat has occupied your spare chair.
CANTEEN: last call for noodles. Reply ALL to place your order.

events.title: Stranded at West Dock
events.raw: West Dock dispatcher: eight ferry workers on the loading platform. The exit ramp is gone. We need a pickup.
events.sensor: A1 · optical: eight stationary figures. Clear sightline; ferry-platform match.

ai.reason: Eight optical detections + dock dispatcher → eight residents stranded at A1.
ai.summary: Eight ferry workers need evacuation from the dock.

events.reveal: The dispatcher and image agree.

events.title: Market rooftop
events.raw: We're six market vendors on the roof by the blue sign. One of us cannot climb back down.
events.sensor: B1 · rooftop beacon and six optical detections. Daylight, unobstructed.

ai.reason: Rooftop beacon + six visible figures → urgent pickup at the market.
ai.summary: Six vendors stranded on the market roof.

events.reveal: Six residents are waiting at the beacon.

events.title: Reef Homes stairwell
events.raw: Reef Homes, east stairwell. There are ten of us. The ground floor is cut off, but everyone is together.
events.sensor: C1 · ten device positions coincide with a confirmed residential call.

ai.reason: Caller headcount corroborated by local beacon → ten residents at C1.
ai.summary: Ten residents isolated above the ground floor.

events.reveal: Caller location and count are accurate.

events.title: Pier maintenance crew
events.raw: East Pier crew: four workers at the service gantry. Access is damaged. We have a flashing work lamp.
events.sensor: D1 · four figures beside a coded work lamp. Positive structure match.

ai.reason: Coded work lamp + four optical detections → crew awaiting rescue.
ai.summary: Four maintenance workers on the East Pier gantry.

events.reveal: The gantry crew matches the report.

events.title: West Dock second call
events.raw: Different group here, south warehouse at West Dock. Five of us were trapped when the shutters jammed.
events.sensor: A1 · independent warehouse beacon. Distinct source from the ferry platform.

ai.reason: Distinct warehouse beacon and caller → separate group, not a repeated dock report.
ai.summary: Five warehouse staff; a separate group from the first call.

events.reveal: A separate group of five is inside the warehouse.

events.title: Elder Grove: low activity
events.raw: Elder Grove night nurse. Twelve residents cannot walk. The ward is behind the ridge. Our corridor lights have failed.
events.sensor: A2 · optical: low contrast, ridge occlusion. Two device signals. Building use: residential care.

ai.reason: Two active signals + no clear optical cluster → low occupancy, low priority.
ai.summary: Two possible occupants. Low-priority assistance request.

events.reveal: Twelve residents need assisted evacuation. The ridge hid the ward.

events.title: Civic Offices: signal cluster
events.raw: Building custodian: Civic Offices closed at dusk. The server racks and desk terminals stay powered overnight.
events.sensor: B2 · 84 active device signals. Access ledger: staff departure complete. No current optical headcount.

ai.reason: 84 active device signals → dense resident cluster, immediate rescue recommended.
ai.summary: Large occupancy detected in Civic Offices.

events.reveal: Only powered terminals remain. Device activity was not a headcount.

events.title: Old Quarter: no signals
events.raw: I'm calling from the public terminal. Ten neighbors are stuck upstairs in Old Quarter. None of them have a working personal communicator.
events.sensor: C2 · zero personal-device signals. Public-terminal call located. Dense roof cover.

ai.reason: Zero active personal signals → sector likely evacuated. No rescue priority.
ai.summary: Old Quarter appears clear; isolated terminal activity.

events.reveal: Ten residents were invisible to the personal-device proxy.

events.title: Glass Garden care home
events.raw: Glass Garden supervisor: all residents transferred before nightfall. Signed evacuation ledger is attached. Please keep the access lane open.
events.sensor: D2 · empty rooms on fresh optical sweep. Evacuation ledger verified by reception.

ai.reason: Reception ledger + fresh empty-room sweep → evacuation complete.
ai.summary: Care home confirmed empty after an earlier transfer.

events.reveal: This care home really was evacuated. Building type alone is not enough.

events.title: Figures behind the clinic
events.raw: Lower Clinic porter: eight patients on the raised rear terrace. We're waving blankets, not equipment covers.
events.sensor: A3 · optical classification: stored equipment. Night exposure, partial canopy obstruction.

ai.reason: Rectangular thermal silhouettes matched to equipment covers → no people detected.
ai.summary: Equipment stored on the clinic's rear terrace.

events.reveal: The silhouettes are patients under blankets, partly hidden by a canopy.

events.title: School call: position drift
events.raw: North School, C3! We're nine from the evening club. NOT Relay Square. The relay is attaching the wrong address to this call.
events.sensor: Location packet: B3. Relay fallback triangulation active; error radius one sector.

ai.reason: Fallback relay position → nine residents assigned to B3.
ai.summary: Nine residents need pickup in Relay Square, B3.

events.reveal: The caller was at North School, C3. The fallback fix drifted west.

events.title: Transit depot crew
events.raw: Transit Yard depot, D3. Seven mechanics on the inspection deck. Local beacon DY-7 is still transmitting.
events.sensor: D3 · local beacon DY-7 received directly. Wide-area relay unavailable.

ai.reason: Direct local beacon + caller location agree → seven residents at D3.
ai.summary: Seven mechanics on the depot inspection deck.

events.reveal: The direct local beacon was accurate even during the relay outage.

events.title: Repeated depot transmission
events.raw: [RETRANSMIT · source DY-7] Transit Yard depot, D3. Seven mechanics on the inspection deck. Local beacon DY-7 is still transmitting.
events.sensor: D3 · repeated source DY-7; matching payload. Relay delivery sequence missing.

ai.reason: New relay delivery identifier → additional group of seven at D3.
ai.summary: A second group of seven reported at Transit Yard.

events.reveal: This is R12 transmitted again, not a second group.

events.title: Relay engineers stranded
events.raw: Two relay engineers in B3, below the square's antenna. Our short-range handset works. The footbridge doesn't.
events.sensor: B3 · short-range handset fix stable. Two emergency suit beacons.

ai.reason: Independent suit beacons + short-range fix → two engineers at B3.
ai.summary: Two engineers await rescue beneath the relay antenna.

events.reveal: The independent beacons remain reliable.

events.title: Hill Homes final pickup
events.raw: Hill Homes, A4. Eight residents at the marked access point. Fresh beacon is on. We can see the West Haven sign.
events.sensor: A4 · restored relay fix + local beacon + eight optical detections agree.

ai.reason: Fresh relay fix and independent beacon agree → eight residents at A4.
ai.summary: Eight residents at the Hill Homes access point.

events.reveal: The restored fix is corroborated by the local beacon.

events.title: Late shift at the annex
events.raw: Research Annex night shift. Six of us were working late. Reception has our roster; we have not evacuated yet.
events.sensor: B4 · six suit beacons. Night-shift roster confirmed. Office use does not imply empty.

ai.reason: Current staffed-shift roster + six suit beacons → six residents remain.
ai.summary: Six night-shift researchers need transport.

events.reveal: Unlike Civic Offices, this workplace has a confirmed occupied night shift.

events.title: Grove Crossing platform
events.raw: Grove Crossing transit marshal. Five passengers left on the raised platform. The stairs are blocked by debris.
events.sensor: C4 · five figures under station lighting. Restored location and marshal's call agree.

ai.reason: Lit-platform optical count + marshal's location → five passengers at C4.
ai.summary: Five passengers on the raised transit platform.

events.reveal: The independently lit scene and current fix are reliable.

events.title: East Terrace last call
events.raw: East Terrace, D4. Seven neighbors at the water tower. One injury; everyone accounted for. The blue beacon is ours.
events.sensor: D4 · blue beacon and seven suit signals. Fresh fix, open sightline.

ai.reason: Beacon match + caller headcount + fresh location → seven residents at D4.
ai.summary: Seven residents at the East Terrace water tower.

events.reveal: All seven residents are at the reported water tower.

events.title: Cedar Point Apartments
events.raw: North School neighbor block, Cedar Point Apartments. Nine of us are on the third-floor landing; the stairwell below is blocked with debris.
events.sensor: C3 · optical: nine stationary figures on an upper landing. Clear sightline.

ai.reason: Nine optical detections + caller headcount → nine residents stranded at C3.
ai.summary: Nine residents need pickup at Cedar Point Apartments.

events.reveal: The caller and the image agree.

events.title: Harborview Care Home
events.raw: Harborview night attendant: eleven residents in the ground-floor day room, none can walk unassisted.
events.sensor: A2 · optical: cluster of eleven low-mobility figures. Night pass, partial occlusion.

ai.reason: Eleven low-mobility detections + attendant call → eleven residents at A2.
ai.summary: Eleven residents need pickup at Harborview Care Home.

events.reveal: The attendant's count matches the night pass.

events.title: Riverside Warehouse Loft
events.raw: Automated beacon ping, Riverside Warehouse Loft: five registered handsets active on the mezzanine level.
events.sensor: D2 · device cluster: five active handsets, no optical confirmation available.

ai.reason: Five device pings clustered on one floor → five residents assumed present at D2.
ai.summary: Five residents likely stranded at the Riverside Warehouse Loft.

events.reveal: A field check confirmed five people on the mezzanine.

events.title: Old Mill Overlook
events.raw: Old Mill Overlook, ground level. Eight of us climbed onto the loading dock when the access road flooded.
events.sensor: A3 · relay fallback fix: eight figures reported, error radius one sector.

ai.reason: Fallback relay position + caller headcount → eight residents assigned to A3.
ai.summary: Eight residents need pickup at the Old Mill Overlook.

events.reveal: The fallback fix held; all eight are at the reported dock.

events.title: Grove Crossing Annex
events.raw: Grove Crossing Annex custodian: six of us are on the loading platform behind the transit hall.
events.sensor: C4 · optical: six stationary figures on a raised platform. Fresh fix, open sightline.

ai.reason: Six optical detections + custodian headcount → six residents at C4.
ai.summary: Six residents need pickup at the Grove Crossing Annex.

events.reveal: The custodian's count matches the fresh image.

events.title: Sunset Terrace Block
events.raw: Sunset Terrace Block, rooftop access. Seven neighbors gathered here after the stairwell flooded below.
events.sensor: B4 · optical: seven stationary figures on a rooftop. Fresh fix, open sightline.

ai.reason: Seven optical detections + caller headcount → seven residents at B4.
ai.summary: Seven residents need pickup at Sunset Terrace Block.

events.reveal: All seven residents are at the reported rooftop.

roadIncidents.title: Collision on Shore Road
roadIncidents.description: Earthquake shaking overturned a delivery van. Traffic is stopped and pedestrians are spilling around the blockage. Send a ground crew to clear the lane.

roadIncidents.title: Earthquake fracture at Civic Bridge
roadIncidents.description: The earthquake split the bridge approach and dropped debris across the lanes. Ground engineers can open a narrow emergency lane.

roadIncidents.title: Crowd at School Crossing
roadIncidents.description: Evacuees have filled the junction. Vehicles lose eight seconds here. Send a ground team to direct traffic.

roadIncidents.title: Ridge Road backup
roadIncidents.description: Evacuation traffic has backed up along Ridge Road. Vehicles lose eight seconds here. Send a ground team to direct traffic.

roadIncidents.title: Waterfront gridlock
roadIncidents.description: Waterfront lanes have gridlocked as residents merge toward the pier. Vehicles lose eight seconds here. Send a ground team to direct traffic.

roadIncidents.title: Hillside bottleneck
roadIncidents.description: Uphill traffic has bottlenecked below the Research Annex. Vehicles lose eight seconds here. Send a ground team to direct traffic.

colleagues.name: Mara
colleagues.text: I know this coast. If a call sounds wrong, read the original before sending anyone.

colleagues.name: Ellis
colleagues.text: Shore Road is blocked. A ground team can clear it, but they will be busy for a while.

colleagues.name: Ellis
colleagues.text: Are you hungry? I am ordering noodles. No? I will put you down as a maybe.

colleagues.name: Mara
colleagues.text: Elder Grove is a care home. A dark window does not mean an empty room.

colleagues.name: Ellis
colleagues.text: Does anyone know where the spare cabinet key went? Never mind. Wrong moment.

colleagues.name: Mara
colleagues.text: The relay is down. Listen for street names in the calls, not just their location tags.

colleagues.name: Mara
colleagues.text: The relay is back. Check the new evidence. You do not need to doubt every report forever.
